name: PleurIA
tagline: A menu-bar planet that cries at every AI request and counts the litres of water your tokens cost.
description: PleurIA puts a small Earth in your menu bar that sheds a tear every time an AI agent receives a request, and keeps a running count of the litres of water your prompts cost the data centres. A playful, slightly guilt-inducing gauge. Everything is computed locally; nothing is sent anywhere.
